title: Puppy eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#e8a95c'/>
  <!-- haunch -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='74' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#d68f42'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#d68f42'/>
  <rect x='46' y='82' width='9' height='12' rx='4' fill='#d68f42'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 60 q12 -4 10 -14' stroke='#d68f42' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='20' fill='#f2bd72'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='30' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#b9732f' transform='rotate(-20 17 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='30' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#b9732f' transform='rotate(20 43 30)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='52' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#fbe3bb'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='48' rx='4' ry='3.2' fill='#3c2a4d'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='3.4' fill='#3c2a4d'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='3.4' fill='#3c2a4d'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snack (bone-shaped cookie) held at mouth -->
  <rect x='6' y='57' width='16' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <circle cx='7' cy='56' r='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <circle cx='7' cy='65' r='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='56' r='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='65' r='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- collar -->
  <rect x='40' y='58' width='22' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4fa3d1' transform='rotate(-14 51 61)'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='58' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8738f'/>
</svg>
